title: The Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture with crisp mix (slight hiss, low‑end thin) of a high‑energy West LA show featuring standout renditions of It's All Over Now, Woman Are Smarter, Ship Of Fools and a fiery Playing In The Band.
ai_review.review: The recording is a decent SBD source – generally clear and well‑balanced though some listeners note a faint hiss and Phil’s bass sitting low in the mix. Musically the concert is praised for its tight vocals, funky West LA vibe and especially the second set where Playin’ In The Band, It’s All Over Now and Ship Of Fools shine, despite a minor miscue on Wheel.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating is ~3.6; most comments are positive about performance and recording with only occasional criticisms, yielding a near‑4‑star overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp SBD with slight hiss; Phil’s bass is thin/lower in the mix, Brent sits high, overall decent balance but occasional mix oddities.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Concise yet tight set, strong second‑set flow with smooth transitions into Space and Wheel; vocals on point and little to no flubs.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Frequently praised for being 'on fire', articulate solos (Might As Well) and overall powerful guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as low in the mix and occasionally lacking punch, though still audible.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mixed remarks – some find his vocals and rhythm guitar hard to hear; others call his singing spot‑on and inspired.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent is highlighted for loud presence, jazzy electric‑piano work, and solid playing throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey & Bill receive strong compliments for responsive, jazz‑like interplay especially during Playing In The Band.
